decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 23rd July 2018 and numbered 059_S01; 059_GE01; 059_S03; 059_EX-GA00; 059_EX-GE01; 059_S02; 059_GA00 (all Rev.P1) Design & Access Statement therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The proposed doorways shall have a threshold that is level with the adjoining footpath and the internal floor ramp shall have a gradient no steeper than 1:15 if its length is less than 5m, or 1:20 if it is longer and a non-slip surface
description: Alterations to shopfront and new shop entrance for 5 Trinity Parade
